description: This file implements the SqlSystemStore class for managing system properties in a Mattermost server, including methods for saving, updating, retrieving, and deleting system configurations in a SQL database.

classes.name: SqlSystemStore
classes.description: A class for managing system configuration data in a SQL database, providing methods for CRUD operations and conditional insert.

methods.name: newSqlSystemStore
methods.description: Initializes a new SqlSystemStore with a query builder for the Systems table.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Inserts a new system property into the database.

methods.name: SaveOrUpdate
methods.description: Inserts or updates a system property, handling conflicts with an UPSERT operation.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates the value of an existing system property.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves all system properties as a map.

methods.name: GetWithContext
methods.description: Retrieves all system properties within a specific request context.

methods.name: GetByName
methods.description: Retrieves a system property by its name.

methods.name: GetByNameWithContext
methods.description: Retrieves a system property by name within a specific request context.

methods.name: PermanentDeleteByName
methods.description: Deletes a system property by name.

methods.name: InsertIfExists
methods.description: Inserts a system property if it does not already exist; returns existing if present.
